note: The bundled songs: six instrumentals made by the author with Suno, included for use with Xenoform. Each ships with its analysis, <id>.features.json, made by scripts/analyse_bundled_songs.py exactly as /api/analyze makes one; that script also measures seconds (ffprobe) and bpm (the analysis). The desk loads a song under the audio id song-<id>.
